title: Cordless Portable Blender For Shakes & Smoothies, Personal Juicer Cup,  BPA-Free Bottle With LED Display, Self-Cleaning Ice Crusher
body_html:
1. FOUR SPEED MODES, ONE CUP FOR EVERYTHING This 2-in-1 blender and juicer gives you four gear settings matched to four blending times. Smoothies, protein shakes, fresh juice, baby food and frozen drinks all come out silky. One button, one cup, done.

2. 22,000 RPM MOTOR + SELF-CLEANING A high-torque motor spins up to 22,000 RPM to break down ice and frozen fruit in seconds, and it runs quietly. Add water, tap self-clean, and the cup rinses itself. No scrubbing, no soaking.

3. TRIPLE SAFETY PROTECTION It shuts off on its own after 5 seconds of idling, stops the moment something jams the blades, and will not start at all unless the cup is locked onto the base. Safe even when you are half asleep at 6 a.m.

4. FOOD-GRADE AND BPA-FREE Food-grade PP + ABS cup, 12 food-grade stainless steel blades, BPA-free throughout. No plastic smell, no aftertaste, and nothing leaching into your morning smoothie.

5. LIGHTWEIGHT WITH LONG BATTERY LIFE Only 490 g, and shaped to sit in a bag or a car cup holder. Long-lasting fast-charge battery with an LED display that shows the remaining charge. Top it up from a wall adapter, a car charger or a power bank.

Product Description

Fresh smoothies, anywhere.

This cordless portable blender packs a 22,000 RPM motor, 12 food-grade stainless steel blades and a 450 ml BPA-free cup into one lightweight body you can carry in one hand.

Four speed modes let you match the blend to the job — a few seconds for a quick protein shake, longer for ice and frozen fruit.

The LED display keeps an eye on the battery level. The self-cleaning mode means you add water, tap, and you're done.

Safety is built in. It stops on its own after 5 seconds of idling. It stops instantly if anything jams the blades. And it won't start until the cup is locked onto the base.

At 490 g it slips into a backpack, a gym bag or a car cup holder. Charge it from a wall outlet, a car charger or a power bank.

Breakfast at home. A shake after the gym. Juice at the office. Anytime, anywhere.
